en: The front of the postcard displays a color illustration of a large historic building surrounded by greenery and water, with a stone bridge and swans swimming in a moat. The building looks like a palace or castle, well-kept and adorned with flowers and trees. The structure, with yellow walls and classic architectural features, is labeled 'PYRMONT-SCHLOSS.' The reverse side of the card features German text describing the site as well as the publication information, British royal crest, and references to 'Raphael Tuck & Sons,' a famous postcard publisher. There is also a stamp 'MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT.'
